e.body:
**ACPR（Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution，法国审慎监管与处置局）** 是**法国的银行与保险审慎监管机构**（隶属法兰西银行 Banque de France）。本条目填补的是**法国这一整块空白**——实测池内**与法国相关的条目为 0**（法国是欧洲最大的保险市场之一）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 120.7KB，正文实测自述「**对法国银行业与保险业行使监管以维护金融稳定**」，并给出当日机构数——**657 家受监管银行机构、660 家受监管保险机构**（页面日期标注 **8th of July 2026**）；**出版物页 `/en/publications-acpr` 194.8KB**，实测含 **《Annual report ACPR 2024》**、**《Annual Report on Sanctioning Activities in the SSM in 2025》**（单一监管机制下的处罚活动年报）等入口。⚠️ **如实记录两处路径异常**：`/en/publications-and-statistics` 实测 **404**、`/en/publications-and-statistics/publications` 实测 **403**——**故词条只给已核实的 `/en/publications-acpr`**，不写未证实的栏目路径。

对 RIAA：**① 补上法国的监管数据入口**——池内监管源已覆盖美、欧（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]）、英、澳、日、韩、台、港、内地、印、新、马、加、菲、印尼，本轮前又补了土耳其（[[seddk]]）、南非（[[fsca]]）、肯尼亚（[[ira-kenya]]）、罗马尼亚（[[asf-romania]]），**法国此前为零**；ACPR 的**机构数、处罚活动与年报**是**「监管强度与实际执行」**这一类研究的直接材料（与 [[naic-financial-data-repository]] 的财务数据、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 的监管数据、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]] 一类治理条目可并读）。**② 法国式「双业合一」监管**——ACPR 同时管**银行与保险**（挂在央行下），而罗马尼亚 ASF 是三合一（[[asf-romania]]）、南非是「审慎 vs 行为」双峰（[[fsca]]）、土耳其是保险与养老金统一（[[seddk]]）——**四个样本放在一起即可做监管架构比较**，以 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 为框架参照。**③ 与法国精算生态配对**——同国专业团体见同轮 [[institut-des-actuaires]]，学术侧可对 [[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-association]]、[[repec-g22]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页正文与机构数、出版物页存在与其中两类年报入口**，**但未打开任何报告**，因此**不能确认报告口径与数据内容**；**②** 两条栏目路径实测 404/403（已如实记录），说明**该站深层栏目对匿名访问并不完全开放**；**③** 机构数（657 / 660）为**页面标注日期下的自述数字**，**未与原始统计交叉核对**；**④** 本站**不含精算模型或工具**，也不提供保险赔付/费率层面的细粒度统计（若要法国市场细数据，需另找 ACPR 的统计出版物或行业机构，**本次未找到可核实入口，如实记录**）。**核实说明**：英文首页（120.7KB）、`/en/publications-acpr`（194.8KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；**两处路径 404/403 已实测确认并记入词条**；**未打开任何报告**。
e.body_en:
**ACPR (Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution)** is **France’s prudential supervisor for banking and insurance** (part of the Banque de France). This entry fills **France as a whole** — a measured search found **zero France-related entries** in the corpus (and France is one of Europe’s largest insurance markets).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is 120.7KB and its body states that the Authority "**exercises oversight over the French banking and insurance sectors in order to maintain financial stability**", alongside institution counts — **657 supervised banking institutions and 660 supervised insurance undertakings** (page dated **8th of July 2026**); the **publications page `/en/publications-acpr`** is 194.8KB and shows entries including **"Annual report ACPR 2024"** and **"Annual Report on Sanctioning Activities in the SSM in 2025"** (sanctioning activity under the Single Supervisory Mechanism). ⚠️ **Two path anomalies are recorded honestly**: `/en/publications-and-statistics` measured **404** and `/en/publications-and-statistics/publications` measured **403** — so **this entry gives only the verified `/en/publications-acpr`** and states no unverified section paths.

For RIAA: **① it adds France’s regulatory data entry point** — the corpus’s regulator sources already cover the US, the EU ([[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]), the UK, Australia, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Canada, the Philippines and Indonesia, and earlier this round Turkey ([[seddk]]), South Africa ([[fsca]]), Kenya ([[ira-kenya]]) and Romania ([[asf-romania]]) were added, while **France was at zero**; ACPR’s **institution counts, sanctioning activity and annual reports** are direct material for research on **supervisory intensity and actual enforcement** (readable alongside the financial data of [[naic-financial-data-repository]], the regulatory data of [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], and governance entries such as [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]] and [[frai]]). **② A French-style "two sectors in one" supervisor** — the ACPR supervises **banking and insurance together** (under the central bank), while Romania’s ASF is three-in-one ([[asf-romania]]), South Africa is twin-peaks prudential versus conduct ([[fsca]]) and Turkey unifies insurance and pensions ([[seddk]]) — **four samples that together support a supervisory-architecture comparison**, framed by [[iais-icp]], [[insurance-europe]] and [[aae-ai-act-position]]. **③ Pairs with the French actuarial ecosystem** — the professional body is [[institut-des-actuaires]] (also added this round), and the academic side is [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[geneva-association]] and [[repec-g22]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage body and institution counts, the publications page and two annual-report entries**, **but opened no report**, so **its definitions and contents cannot be confirmed**; **②** two section paths measured 404/403 (recorded), showing that **the site’s deeper sections are not fully open to anonymous access**; **③** the counts (657 / 660) are **the site’s own figures as of its stated date** and **were not cross-checked against primary statistics**; **④** the site **offers no actuarial models or tools**, nor fine-grained claims or rate-level statistics for the French market (French market detail would require ACPR’s statistical publications or an industry body — **no verifiable entry point was found in this check, recorded honestly**). **Verification note**: the English homepage (120.7KB) and `/en/publications-acpr` (194.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their text read; **the two 404/403 paths were measured and recorded**; **no report was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ACPR（Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution，法國審慎監管與處置局）** 是**法國的銀行與保險審慎監管機構**（隸屬法蘭西銀行）。本條目填補**法國這一整塊空白**——實測池內**法國相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 120.7KB，正文實測自述「**對法國銀行業與保險業行使監管以維護金融穩定**」，並給出機構數——**657 家受監管銀行機構、660 家受監管保險機構**（頁面日期 **8th of July 2026**）；**出版物頁 `/en/publications-acpr` 194.8KB**，實測含 **《Annual report ACPR 2024》**、**《Annual Report on Sanctioning Activities in the SSM in 2025》**。⚠️ **如實記錄兩處路徑異常**：`/en/publications-and-statistics` 實測 **404**、`…/publications` 實測 **403**——**故詞條只給已核實的 `/en/publications-acpr`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上法國監管數據入口**——**法國此前為零**；ACPR 的**機構數、處罰活動與年報**是**「監管強度與實際執行」**研究的直接材料（可並讀 [[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]]）。**② 法國式「雙業合一」監管**——ACPR 同時管**銀行與保險**，而羅馬尼亞 ASF 三合一（[[asf-romania]]）、南非「審慎 vs 行為」雙峰（[[fsca]]）、土耳其保險與養老金統一（[[seddk]]）——**四個樣本可做監管架構比較**，以 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 為框架。**③ 與法國精算生態配對**——同輪 [[institut-des-actuaires]]，學術側 [[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[repec-g22]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁正文與機構數、出版物頁與兩類年報入口**，**但未打開任何報告**；**②** 兩條欄目路徑實測 404/403（已記錄），說明**深層欄目對匿名訪問並不完全開放**；**③** 機構數為**頁面標注日期下的自述數字**，**未與原始統計交叉核對**；**④** 本站**不含精算模型或工具**，亦無保險賠付/費率層面細粒度統計（**本次未找到可核實入口，如實記錄**）。**核實說明**：英文首頁、`/en/publications-acpr` HTTP 200 實測並讀取正文；**兩處 404/403 已實測確認並記入詞條**；**未打開任何報告**。
